# Security policy

If you find a security problem in OksaSDR (the mobile app in this
repository), please report it privately rather than in a public issue:
email oh6oksa@gmail.com, or use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/OH6OKSA/OksaSDR/security/advisories/new).
Include what you found, how to reproduce it and the app build it affects.
You will get an answer within a few days.

Security problems in the desktop AetherSDR belong to the upstream project:
https://github.com/aethersdr/AetherSDR/security
